title: Théorie arithmétique. Théorie de Galois des motifs (1965) : notes manuscites (s.d.), tapuscrit (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting: Grothendieck is listing the 'realizations at the infinite places' of a motive xi over an arithmetic base X, as part of the Galois theory of motives. Notation: x is a complex point lying over a point a. xi_{x,Z} is the integral Betti realization at x. xi_{x,infty} is the Hodge-de Rham realization over C, i.e. H_B ⊗ C ≅ H_dR ⊗ C with its Hodge filtration. xi_{a,infty} is the de Rham realization over the residue field k(a), which may be R.

(1) Complex point. Besides the integral structure on the Hodge-de Rham functor, one has the conjugation of types, H^{p,q} <-> H^{q,p}. It is determined by the filtration together with the antilinear involution tau' = id ⊗ c on xi_{x,infty} = xi_{x,R} ⊗_R C, where xi_{x,R} = xi_{x,Z} ⊗ R. Since H^{q,p} is the conjugate of H^{p,q}, the Hodge decomposition is recovered from F^p and its tau'-conjugate. Grothendieck calls tau' the 'transcendental' semilinear involution.

(2) Real point (k(a) = R). There is a second antilinear involution tau''. It comes from the algebraic (de Rham) real structure xi_{x,infty} ≅ (xi_{a,infty})_R ⊗_R C. He calls it the 'algebraic' one.
- The C-linear involution tau induced on (xi_{x,Z})_C is the composite tau = tau' tau'' = tau'' tau'. Here tau is the action of complex conjugation on the complex points, i.e. Deligne's F_infty.
- Equivalently, the de Rham conjugation equals F_infty ⊗ c_B. This is exactly the relation Deligne later states in 'Valeurs de fonctions L et périodes d'intégrales' (1979).

(3) Two equivalent descriptions of the local data at a real place, a 'real Hodge-de Rham structure':
- (a) The real de Rham space Fix(tau'') = xi_{a,infty} with its filtration. On it tau restricts to tau' and becomes an R-linear involution (the 'transcendental involution').
- (b) Better: the real Betti space Fix(tau') = xi_{x,R} with tau = tau''. This tau descends from an involution of the lattice xi_{x,Z}, i.e. the integral F_infty.
- So the boxed datum is 'tau on xi_{a,Z}': a Z-Hodge structure with an integral involution F_infty, compatible with the Hodge structure by conjugating types.

(4) Final remark: this tau is the action of pi_1(X), i.e. of the decomposition group Z/2 at the real place inside the arithmetic fundamental group. He flags 'problèmes avec la place réelle -!' and writes 'à vérifier' in the margin twice.

Purpose: to define the archimedean analogue of the l-adic Galois realization. These are exactly the archimedean local data (Hodge numbers plus F_infty eigenspaces) that later determine Gamma-factors (Serre 1970) and Deligne's periods c^±.
errors: The line 'τ = τ′ involution transcendante (qui est R-linéaire sur les deux espaces)' is loose. τ = τ′τ″ restricts to τ′ on Fix(τ″) only because τ′ and τ″ commute. The phrasing is correct only in that sense.

Notation slips between x and a: 'Si k(x) est réel' should presumably be k(a), x being the complex point over a, and ξ_{x,Z} vs ξ_{a,Z} is used inconsistently. Grothendieck himself marks the passage 'à vérifier'.

'Problèmes avec la place réelle' is left unresolved. Identifying τ with an element of π_1(X) for a real place requires choosing the decomposition group; only its conjugacy class is canonical. The sign and Tate-twist issues (complex conjugation acting on Z(1) by −1) are not addressed.

ideas.what: Conjugation of Hodge types (p,q)->(q,p) encoded by the antilinear Betti involution together with the Hodge filtration
ideas.modern_name: Hodge symmetry / complex conjugation of a Hodge structure
ideas.usually_credited_to: Hodge; formalized by Deligne (Théorie de Hodge II, 1971)

ideas.what: At a real place, F_infty (action of complex conjugation on Betti cohomology) equals the composite of the Betti antilinear involution and the de Rham antilinear involution: τ = τ′τ″
ideas.modern_name: c_dR = F_∞ ⊗ c_B; real Hodge structure with F_∞ (realization at the real place)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Deligne, 'Valeurs de fonctions L et périodes d'intégrales' (1979)

ideas.what: Local data at the real place equivalently described as the integral Betti lattice with involution F_infty plus Hodge filtration (boxed 'τ sur ξ_{a,Z}')
ideas.modern_name: Integral/real Hodge structures with F_∞ (Fontaine–Perrin-Riou style archimedean realization)

ideas.what: Identification of F_infty with the action of the decomposition group at a real place inside π_1 of the arithmetic base (archimedean analogue of Frobenius)
ideas.modern_name: Frobenius at infinity / archimedean decomposition group

missed.claim: Around 1965 (the cote is dated 1965 to c.1977), Grothendieck explicitly decomposes F_∞ on H_B⊗C as the product of the 'transcendental' (Betti) and 'algebraic' (de Rham) antilinear involutions. He takes 'Hodge-de Rham réel' plus the integral involution as the realization at a real place. This is the structure usually attributed to Deligne's 1979 periods paper.
missed.quote: τ = τ′τ″ = τ″τ′ ... ½ linéaire transcendant ; ½ linéaire algébrique (dans le cas réel)
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: This is a historical priority/genealogy point for the archimedean realization in Deligne's and Beilinson's conjectures. It is not new mathematics today.

missed.claim: He flags unresolved 'problems with the real place' when viewing τ as the π_1(X)-action, i.e. integrating archimedean places into the arithmetic fundamental group / motivic Galois group.
missed.quote: [or c'est là l'action de π_1(X), problèmes avec la place réelle -!]
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Treating archimedean places on the same footing as finite ones in the motivic Galois formalism remains only partially systematized. Examples are Weil-group or 'Hodge at infinity' realizations, Deninger's archimedean cohomology, and the real Weil group in Langlands.

deep.surprise_reason: This is a clean early (likely 1965) formulation of the real-place realization (Hodge structure plus F_∞, with c_dR = F_∞∘c_B) that is usually credited to Deligne 1979. The mathematics is standard today, so the interest is purely chronological. The dating within the folder is uncertain.
transcription_corrections: 'Si k(x) est réel' is probably 'Si k(a) est réel' (a = the base point, x the complex point over it).
'l'échange des entiers h-conjugués' is probably 'l'échange des types conjugués' / of (p,q) and (q,p); the reading is uncertain.
Line 5 likely reads 'On peut aussi la considérer comme [est déterminée via filtration] par cette dernière (par l'opération τ ½ linéaire involution τ′ dans ξ_{x,∞} ...)'.
'½ linéaire transcendant' under τ′ is more likely '½ linéaire transcendante'.
In the boxed line and the preceding one, ξ_{a,Z} vs ξ_{x,Z}: the image shows ξ_{a,Z} in the box.
